About the role

We're hiring a Finance &amp; Strategy Analyst to join the Product Finance FP&amp;A team and own the financial story behind some of Coinbase's most dynamic revenue lines, including Consumer Trading, Developer, and Stablecoin products. This team provides forecasting, variance analysis, and strategic insights across all revenue and expense lines for the product groups, partnering cross-functionally with Business Operations, Data, Accounting, Treasury, Investor Relations, and HR. You'll build the models and deliver the analysis that help leadership understand what's driving performance, where the risks and opportunities are, and where to focus next.
